nuggets.title: Too many users on one server

scenario.symptoms: When lots of people use the site at the same time, only one server struggles and the rest stay quiet.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Nugget-basics warm-up (onboarding). Component: load-balancer. Put a load balancer in front of multiple app servers so requests spread across them.

data.label: Scenario
data.note: When lots of people use the site at the same time, only one server struggles and the rest stay quiet.

incident.headline: Too many users on one server

agenda.goal: Put a load balancer in front of multiple app servers so requests spread across them.
agenda.opener: Traffic keeps hitting one place. What kind of change would spread the load?

evidence.strong: Put a load balancer in front of multiple app servers so requests spread across them.
evidence.adequate: Names a reasonable fix direction related to load balancer.
evidence.weak: Restates the symptom without a concrete fix or misidentifies the failing part.

agenda.referenceFix: Put a load balancer in front of multiple app servers so requests spread across them.

scenario.symptoms: Every page view asks the database for the same popular data. The database stays busy even when traffic is normal.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Nugget-basics warm-up (onboarding). Component: cache. Add a cache in front of the database for frequently read data.

data.label: Scenario

scenario.symptoms: Saving new users and posts gets slower every month. One database holds everything and is running out of room.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Nugget-basics warm-up (onboarding). Component: database. Shard or partition data across multiple databases using a key such as user id.

scenario.symptoms: After someone updates their profile, friends still see the old name for several minutes.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Nugget-basics warm-up (onboarding). Component: cache. Invalidate or update the cache on write, shorten TTL, or read from the source of truth for that user right after they edit.

scenario.symptoms: A single popular product page gets almost all visits. That one part of the system melts while everything else looks fine.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Nugget-basics warm-up (onboarding). Component: partitioning. Spread hot reads with replication, local caching, or splitting the hot key; avoid sending all traffic to one partition.
